purpose: grade-1 reachable-accuracy bounds, size-matched nulls, encoding-cost accounting and register-purity inventory for exp73's TRUNCATED AMPLITUDE ladder, computed BEFORE any exp73_*.py exists (doc 55 SS19.2's ordering rule, inherited; Rule 4)

sign_pin_pc1_pc2.rule: pinned to the frozen vec2 plane, exactly as instrument_sb_bounds.load_raw does

sign_pin_pc3_onwards.rule: sign( Vt[k, argmax_j |Vt[k,j]| ] ) = +1, ties -> lowest j
sign_pin_pc3_onwards.why: intrinsic to the axis: it depends on the loading vector alone, not on row order or inventory order. Bounds are invariant to it (asserted, SS`check_sign_invariance`); a trained circuit is not, which is why it is pinned.

raw_family.leakage_note: PCA is fit over the FULL 44-noun inventory, matching exp42_make_embeddings.py and load_raw. NOT leakage in this setting: the held-out split is over unseen PAIRINGS, not unseen nouns (load_raw's own note).

provenance.extends: instrument_entangled_bounds.py's general joint-map machinery to AMPLITUDE encodings. The only new object is the per-referent feature (the outer square of the normalised truncated vector); the row builder, the twin seeding, the search, the sign-flip invariant and the null discipline are the committed ones, called and not copied.

pca_convention.reading: the amplitude ladder and every committed bound stand on the same PCA, the same sign pin and the same inventory; only the number of components differs

A1_linear_form.identity: L v(phi) = u(2 phi), v = (x0^2, x0 x1, x1^2)

A1_doubled_angle_raw.reading: the 1-qubit amplitude bound EQUALS the committed single-angle bound at DOUBLED angle, exactly, in both modes -- that is the right check and it is asserted. Whether it also equals the same-angle bound is a separate, purely empirical matter and is reported, never asserted: angle doubling is a bijective relabelling of the inventory but not a linear map of the features, so the two need not agree, and 'amplitude encoding is not a reparameterisation of the angle encoding' is a measurement here rather than an assumption.

reparameterisation_invariance.claim: MAX-FS over Phi = vec(v_a v_p^T) is invariant under v -> A v for invertible A, because W -> (A (x) A)^{-T} W is a bijection of the readout space. ASSERTED on the exact pair-mode path; the twin-mode search is a heuristic and its coordinate-dependence is reported, not asserted away.

A1_separation.mode: pair (EXACT R^3 arrangement enumeration on every row)
A1_separation.reading: the doubled-angle identity is a THEOREM and holds on every inventory; the same-angle agreement is an INVENTORY-SPECIFIC COINCIDENCE and fails on most random inventories. Amplitude encoding of a unit 2-vector is therefore NOT a reparameterisation of the committed angle encoding -- it is the same feature space at double frequency, which reorders the inventory around the circle.

A1_committed_inventory_all_categories.reading: on THIS inventory the same-angle value coincides with the amplitude value in every category. Reported as a coincidence and NOT as a finding: `A1_separation` shows it fails on most random inventories, so nothing follows from it about the amplitude rungs A3/A4, whose feature spaces are not 3-dimensional and have no angle analogue at all.

saturation_certificate.note: the certificate must NOT fire at A1 (d_joint 9 < 160 rows) and A2 (100 < 160); if it did, the rank test would be meaningless. That failing direction is asserted, not assumed.

quadratic_form_identity.identity: x^T M x = <W, v(x)> with v the triu outer square and W = triu(M) with the off-diagonals doubled -- SS1, checked on random symmetric M at d = 2, 4, 8, 16

measurement_is_a_quadratic_form.statement: p(x) = <psi(x)|O|psi(x)> = x^T M x, M = M^T real
measurement_is_a_quadratic_form.classical_comparator_implied: a QUADRATIC (kernel) model on the raw features: linear in the degree-2 monomials of x, equivalently the kernel (x_a . x_a')^2 (x_p . x_p')^2 on the two-referent decision. This is EVEN MORE IMMEDIATE than the angle maps' matched comparator -- it is the same object in another basis (doc 52 SS1's prohibition applies at its strongest).
measurement_is_a_quadratic_form.general_W_qualifier: W ranges over the whole coordinate space; the physically realisable M are a subset. The committed modules make the same identification and this one inherits it verbatim, which is what makes these numbers comparable with theirs.

encoding_map.formula: x(r) = z_{1:d}(r) / ||z_{1:d}(r)||_2, z = the sign-pinned raw PCA scores, zero-padded to 2^q (vacuous when d = 2^q)
encoding_map.information_cost_vs_eps_map: the eps-map is injective and affine and destroys NO information -- its cost is angular RESOLUTION, forced by the concurrence dead zones. The amplitude map is lossy TWICE: truncation discards 1 - cumvar(d) of the variance, and unit-l2 normalisation discards the radius, exactly one real number per referent -- the same number FA discarded relative to F2. Per-referent free coordinates: FA 1, F2/P-eps 2, amplitude d - 1.

A1.per_register_purity_note: EXACTLY 1 for both referents: the two registers are introduced as a PRODUCT of two pure states and no cross-referent entangler exists at intro. doc 56's concurrence question DOES NOT ARISE at this rung; the exp73 assertion is on this quantity, to 1e-9.
A1.reading: intro per-WIRE purity is below 1 by CONSTRUCTION -- a generic unit vector in R^{2^q} is not a product of q single-qubit states -- and it is a DATA-DETERMINED constant of the encoding, not a circuit effect. The committed per-wire trace (doc 55 SS18.3) must therefore be read against THIS inventory as its baseline, and the exp73 instrumentation records the per-REGISTER trace alongside it.

bound_of_record_note.A1/A2: no committed bound exists for either; A1 is the selftest rung and A2 is a sensitivity row, NOTED NOT RUN.
bound_of_record_note.A3/A4: EXACT 1.0000 by the saturation certificate (SS4) if the certificate fired -- read `method` on each row, never the number alone (doc 47 SS18.5).
bound_of_record_note.binding_rule: doc 55 SS6 / SS12: NO exp73 criterion reads against any number in this file. doc 54 SS17.7 is the standing reason, and SS4's saturation makes it mechanical rather than merely prudent.

grade3_under_conversion_flag.flag: under-conversion predicted for a BELOW-NULL category (doc 55 SS19.2 grade 3, made prospective)
grade3_under_conversion_flag.verdict: UNTESTABLE THIS RUN -- no exp73 rung has a below-null category. Computed before freezing and recorded rather than quietly dropped, exactly as doc 55 SS19.2 did for exp69 and doc 56 for exp70.

saturation_finding.statement: at every rung whose joint coordinate space is at least as large as the number of MAX-FS rows, the rows are of full rank and the optimum is EXACTLY the row count. The bound is 1.0000 by PROOF, and so is every size-matched null draw's.
saturation_finding.consequence_registered_as_a_result: the grade-1 instrument DISCRIMINATES NOTHING at the amplitude rung -- not A3 from A4, not the category from its null, and not amplitude from the committed 2-qubit angle registers whose bounds are already 1.0000 (doc 58 SS11). Every exp73 criterion is therefore measurement-vs-measurement, and the standard bound-referenced bug-hunt gate is STRUCTURALLY INERT here in doc 58 SS9.5's exact sense: bound + 0.06 > 1 and no achievable accuracy can trigger it.
saturation_finding.what_it_does_NOT_say: it does NOT say the amplitude encoding is expressive in any useful sense. Saturation is a statement about a 1296- or 18496-dimensional linear model on 160 constraints; it is the SAME degeneracy that makes the tier-(ii) classical comparator vacuous at these widths, and the doc registers a capacity-matched comparator tier for exactly that reason.
